result.summary: Found several visual/layout issues: truncated restaurant names and delivery info, overlapping text on a card, and cut-off category chips and food cards.

issues.description: Delivery time text on Tokumaru Ramen Bar is garbled/overlapping: '25-30delivery' appears as broken text ('25-3Ddelivery' style) instead of clean '25-30 min delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Fix text layout/spacing so delivery time and category read clearly as separate labels (e.g. '25-30 min · Ramen') without character collision or overflow.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated and cut off on the right edge of the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow full name on wrap, use ellipsis consistently with enough padding, or make the horizontal list scroll with complete visible titles.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is clipped on the right (Healthy and following chip partially off-screen) with no clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll is obvious (peek of next chip, fade, or arrows) and that chips aren’t cut mid-label without scrolling.

issues.description: Bottom promotional/popular card (pizza) is heavily cropped at the bottom of the viewport, hiding title, rating, and other details.
issues.suggestion: Adjust scroll area/padding above the tab bar so card content isn’t obscured, or ensure the list scrolls fully above the fixed nav.

issues.description: Fastest near you third card is only partially visible, cutting off image and text awkwardly.
issues.suggestion: Show a clearer peek of the next card or tighten card widths so content doesn’t feel unfinished at the edge.

issues.description: Inconsistent delivery badge formatting (some '€x.xx delivery', popular card '€0 delivery', time badges over images) and tight spacing make the hierarchy slightly uneven.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge styles, padding, and label formats across restaurant cards for a cleaner visual rhythm.
